title: Rabbi Yosta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a disciple of Resh Lakish. In [Yerushalmi Bava Metzia, chapter 10, halakhah 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Metzia.10.2): “Rabbi Yosta in the name of Resh Lakish: the lower owner provides the ceiling.” In the Bavli there, [117a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.117a), his name appears as Vestina, followed by “Resh Lakish said”; Dikdukei Soferim cites the variant Yostani. [Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:8:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.4.8.2) gives “Rabbi Chunya in the name of Rabbi Yosta.” It appears that he is the Rabbi Yostina mentioned in [Bava Batra, chapter 8, halakhah 5](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Batra.8.5), who had a case before the rabbis, was found liable, and appeared before Resh Lakish. At the beginning of Ketubot, chapter 9: “The rabbis of Rabbi Yostina asked Rabbi Yochanan.”[^1]

notes.text: The digital Bavli reads ו[יו]סטיני, alongside Hyman’s Vestina and the Yostani reading he reports. The Yerushalmi Ketubot parallel instead presents a property dispute involving Rabbi Yostinei and does not reproduce Hyman’s question to Yochanan.
